subject: Future Tech
title: IBM's Quantum Roadmap
description: A micro-lesson that makes IBM's Quantum Roadmap usable.

hook.text: IBM published a public roadmap for quantum computers, promising milestones years ahead. No rival matched that.

buildup.text: The roadmap tracks qubit count, gate fidelity, and quantum volume, a metric for overall machine performance.

discovery.text: In 2023, IBM unveiled the Condor chip with 1,121 superconducting qubits, hitting its roadmap target on time.

twist.text: But more qubits alone don't equal useful computing. IBM shifted focus to error mitigation and modular design.

climax.text: Their Qiskit platform lets developers run circuits on real quantum hardware through the cloud for free.

punchline.text: IBM bets that openness wins the quantum race.

quiz.question: What metric does IBM use for overall quantum performance?
